title: hibiscus surattensis var. rostellatus
intro: Hibiscus surattensis var. rostellatus, commonly known as "Red Cotton Hibiscus", is a variety of the Hibiscus surattensis plant, a species of flowering plant in the mallow family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus surattensis var. rostellatus are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic agent, helping to protect against cell damage and improve cardiovascular health. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
